t: That this Act may be cited as the “Shipping Act Amendments of 1979”.

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision naming the Act; it establishes no process, consultation, rulemaking, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. The only possible temptation is that the Shipping Act itself may involve regulatory processes elsewhere, but nothing in this section's text provides for outside-party involvement in a federal decision.

opus.w: This section only gives the Act its short title. It does not require or allow any consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. The tempting link to Shipping Act regulation has no support in the text itself.
opus.b:

That reading fails because this section is just the short title. It sets up no process, and no one outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
